title: Pullman house's pavilion windows framed like the rest of the front
items: The four round-arched windows on the two Prairie Avenue pavilions now carry the moulded frames the 1890 Albertype plate shows round every arched window on that front: bands, impost blocks, and keystones on the principal storey.
Bay windows can take a moulded frame now, built the same way as the frames on a front wall's own windows.
